--- create_sequence_multiple_params.sql
CREATE SEQUENCE S BIT_REVERSED_POSITIVE SKIP RANGE 1, 10 START COUNTER WITH 11 OPTIONS (sequence_kind = 'bit_reversed_positive')

--- AST
&ast.CreateSequence{
  Name: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 16,
        NameEnd: 17,
        Name:    "S",
      },
    },
  },
  Params: []ast.SequenceParam{
    &ast.BitReversedPositive{
      BitReversedPositive: 18,
    },
    &ast.SkipRange{
      Skip: 40,
      Min:  &ast.IntLiteral{
        ValuePos: 51,
        ValueEnd: 52,
        Base:     10,
        Value:    "1",
      },
      Max: &ast.IntLiteral{
        ValuePos: 54,
        ValueEnd: 56,
        Base:     10,
        Value:    "10",
      },
    },
    &ast.StartCounterWith{
      Start:   57,
      Counter: &ast.IntLiteral{
        ValuePos: 76,
        ValueEnd: 78,
        Base:     10,
        Value:    "11",
      },
    },
  },
  Options: &ast.Options{
    Options: 79,
    Rparen:  127,
    Records: []*ast.OptionsDef{
      &ast.OptionsDef{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 88,
          NameEnd: 101,
          Name:    "sequence_kind",
        },
        Value: &ast.StringLiteral{
          ValuePos: 104,
          ValueEnd: 127,
          Value:    "bit_reversed_positive",
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE SEQUENCE S BIT_REVERSED_POSITIVE SKIP RANGE 1, 10 START COUNTER WITH 11 OPTIONS (sequence_kind = "bit_reversed_positive")
